title: Proper Service
verse: And he said to them, “It is written, ‘’ but you are turning it into !
observation: Jesus was not mad because they were selling things at “church.” The people coming to worship were from all over the known world. They would not be able to provide a spotless lamb or other offerings without being able to buy them. However, He was objecting to gouging the people and exploiting their need. We must be careful not to do the same. The Church should not be in the business of gouging people. It is okay to charge for expenses to provide a service. It is not okay to “sell” worship. The subtle and not so subtle difference shown here can be found in many areas of life. It all comes down to motive and abusing a good thing. What are some other areas where you can see this wisdom is needed?
application: Is there another area of your life where you need to apply the wisdom of balance?
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for showing us the difference in many areas of life.
